name: orbital_dynamics
description: Planar test-particle apparatus with finite center resolution and positive-time Cartesian velocity impulses.
public_contract: Only World.describe() and observations are agent-facing. Source, manifest, strata, numerical references and diagnostics are operator-only.
version_policy: Registered as the ninth experimental world with a public pilot claim lag of 0.25 T after reset and each impulse at or before the readout, and matched comparison times. Assigned resets and instantaneous impulse jumps are not discovery. Registration does not establish difficulty, discovery depth or independent review approval; existing frozen cohorts and historical scores are unchanged.
